import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 524293; // 1<<19 + 5
    static int N, K, MOD, maxN;
    static int[] bitCount = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] F = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[][] A = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static int[][] B = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static int[][] C = new int[20][MAX_N];
    static long MOD_SQ;
    static long[][] TMP = new long[20][MAX_N];
    static long[] FACT = new long[MAX_N];
    static long[] INV_FACT = new long[MAX_N];

    static long mod_exp(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void init_arrays() {
        FACT[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= maxN; ++i)
            FACT[i] = FACT[i-1] * i % MOD;
        INV_FACT[maxN] = mod_exp(FACT[maxN], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = maxN - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            INV_FACT[i] = INV_FACT[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
    }

    static int next_pow2(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void fwht(int[] arr, int len, boolean inv) {
        long[] buf = new long[MAX_N];
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) buf[i] = arr[i];
        
        if (inv) {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        long x = buf[i + j], y = buf[i + j + step];
                        buf[i + j + step] = (x - y) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += step << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < step; ++j) {
                        long x = buf[i + j], y = buf[i + j + step];
                        buf[i + j + step] = (x + y) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            arr[i] = (int)(buf[i] % MOD);
            if (arr[i] < 0) arr[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static void mod_sub(long[] x, int idx) {
        if (x[idx] >= MOD_SQ) x[idx] -= MOD_SQ;
    }

    static void convolve() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(TMP[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            A[bitCount[i]][i] = F[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(A[i], maxN + 1, false);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                    TMP[q + l][s] += 1L * A[q][s] * B[l][s];
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                C[q][s] = (int)(TMP[q][s] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(C[i], maxN + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            F[i] = C[bitCount[i]][i];
    }

    static void square_B() {
        int[][] buf = new int[20][MAX_N];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(TMP[i], 0);
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int l = 0; q + l <= 19; ++l)
                for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                    TMP[q + l][s] += 1L * B[q][s] * B[l][s];
        
        for (int q = 0; q <= 19; ++q)
            for (int s = 0; s <= maxN; ++s)
                buf[q][s] = (int)(TMP[q][s] % MOD);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(buf[i], maxN + 1, true);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            Arrays.fill(B[i], 0);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            B[bitCount[i]][i] = buf[bitCount[i]][i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(B[i], maxN + 1, false);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        MOD_SQ = 1L * MOD * MOD;
        
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(mod_exp(K, N));
            return;
        }
        
        F[0] = 1;
        maxN = next_pow2(N + 1) - 1;
        init_arrays();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            bitCount[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; ++i)
            B[bitCount[i]][i] = (int)INV_FACT[i];
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i)
            fwht(B[i], maxN + 1, false);
        
        int origK = K;
        while (K > 0) {
            if ((K & 1) == 1) convolve();
            K >>= 1;
            if (K > 0) square_B();
        }
        
        long result = (mod_exp(origK, N) - FACT[N] * F[N] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
